title: Concept-Guided Exploration: Building Persistent, Actionable Scene Graphs
description:
arXiv:2608.23650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The perception of 3D space by mobile robots is rapidly moving from flat metric grid representations to hybrid metric-semantic graphs built from human-interpretable concepts. While most approaches first build metric maps and then add semantic layers, we explore an alternative, concept-first architecture in which spatial understanding emerges from asynchronous concept agents that directly instantiate and manage semantic entities.
